checks: A: whom links a supplementary clause to the three people after all of; them creates an unattached finite clause, which/whose fail the referent/form.

activeQuestion.prompt: The committee has narrowed the search to three candidates, all of ____ have extensive management experience.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 委員會已將人選縮小至三位，這三位都有豐富的管理經驗。（英文空格測試關係代名詞。）

options.zh: 關係代名詞，指三位候選人
options.whyZh: all of whom 引導補充描述三位候選人的關係子句。
此處需關係代名詞連接子句，不能只用受格。
先行詞為人，介系詞後應用 whom。
whose 必須作所有格限定名詞。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: all of whom 引導補充描述三位候選人的關係子句。
activeQuestion.evidence: The committee has narrowed the search to three candidates, all of whom have extensive management experience.

vocabulary.note: narrow the search 表示減少候選選項。
